text:
sara: Cutting RC candidate rc/2026-03-21-5 from main. Triggering CI now — window for promo is 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need QA signoff by 15:00 PT. Can ops and oncall ack? :rocket:

deploy-bot: build succeeded for rc/2026-03-21-5 at 1758887776. Artifact: release-service:sha:abc123def. CI: https://ci.example.com/builds/1758887776. KV warm job queued.

alex: I can take QA. Starting smoke tests on staging now: smoke -> quick perf -> regression prompts. Will post results here.

mike: Tagged candidate in infra: pin release-service=sha:abc123def on staging. KVs warming (staging) — kicked kv-warm job id=9876.

deploy-bot: kv-warm job 9876 started. Logs: https://ci.example.com/logs/9876. ETA ~5m.

emily: Quick perf snapshot from staging: p95=88ms, p99=210ms, no tokenization regressions on our smoke prompts. Found minor lint in metrics exporter, non-blocker.

alex: QA PASS from me. Recommend promote to prod canary at 02:10 UTC within the window. Suggest 2% for 30m, then 25% and full if green. @rachel please ack and post rollback plan. :thumbsup:

rachel: Acked — I'll be oncall for the promo. Rollback plan: immediate traffic flip to previous candidate + pin back to sha:fae11. On alert >3% error rate or any 5xx spike for 5m we abort. Rollback command (ops-runbook):
```
# rollback to previous prod artifact
kubectl set image deployment/release-service release-service=release-service:sha:fae11 -n prod
# if we need traffic-only flip (feature flag):
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' https://flags.example.com/api/toggles/release-service/rollout -d '{"state":"previous"}'
```

sara: Promo request: @deploy-bot promote rc/2026-03-21-5 -> prod canary. Policy: 2% for 30m, then 25% -> 100% if green. Keep KV warmers running during ramp. Notify #incidents if alerts fire.

deploy-bot: deploybot: starting promotion job 4444. Canary 2% target. Estimated warm time 6m. Notifying oncall.

rachel: Monitoring hooks enabled: canary dashboard, slowlog alert, token-error rate watcher. I set a PagerDuty escalation if error rate breaches threshold.

deploy-bot: Promotion reached 2% at 02:11 UTC; artifact sha:abc123def pinned to prod-route for canary.

emily: Observability check: error rate stable, p99 unchanged, no regressions in eval set. Rolling canary metrics look green.

mike: Keeping KV warmers running and scheduling background fill before the 25% step. Will verify cold-start rates.

sara: Noted. Release notes draft (short):
- Improved batching kernels for short sequences (lower p95)
- Fix memory leak in KV cache (reduces background OOM)
- Minor telemetry cleanup in metrics exporter
I'll open the release-notes PR after full promotion.

alex: Signed off from QA. @sara proceed to 25% at +30m if canary remains green. Good job team. :tada:

rachel: I'll keep eyes on it for the next 90m and will initiate rollback if we hit the thresholds discussed.

sara: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread open for the full promo window. If anyone sees anything odd, post here and tag @rachel.
